subject: Request for SOC 2 Type II report and audit coverage letter
messages:
From: Elena Martinez <security@acme-corp.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.com
Cc: kimberly.park@redwood.com
Date: 2026-02-13T15:21:00-05:00
Subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II report and coverage letter

Hi Marissa,

We're progressing through our procurement compliance checks for the upcoming integration with Redwood. As part of our security review we need two items:

1) A copy of your most recent SOC 2 Type II report (PDF), including the auditor identification and report date.
2) A coverage/bridge letter (sometimes called an "audit coverage statement") that attests there have been no material changes to the control environment since the report end date and extends coverage to a date in late February 2026 (we're targeting 02/28/2026).

For context, our procurement timeline needs both documents by 02/20/2026 if possible. If you can't meet that exact date please let us know an alternative.

Also let us know the audit period covered by the report (start/end dates) and the auditor name. We may also request a one-paragraph attestation in the bridge letter confirming whether there have been any major incidents or additions of new subprocessors since the report end date.

Attached is our standard security questionnaire for reference.

Thanks,

Elena Martinez
Senior Security Analyst
Acme Corporation
Attachments: Acme_Security_Questionnaire_20260213.xlsx (stub)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Elena Martinez <security@acme-corp.com>
Cc: kimberly.park@redwood.com, aditya.rao@redwood.com
Date: 2026-02-13T16:05:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II report and coverage letter

Hi Elena —

Thanks for the clear note and the questionnaire. We're happy to provide the SOC 2 Type II report and a bridge/coverage letter. Quick answers up front:

- Audit period for our most recent SOC 2 Type II is 2024-10-01 through 2025-09-30.
- Auditor: Brightline CPA LLP. Final report date: 2025-11-20.

I've looped in Aditya from Security to draft the bridge letter and pull the PDF. Our target internally is to share a draft bridge by 2026-02-17 and a final signed version by 2026-02-19, which would meet your 02/20 procurement cutoff. If you need it sooner we can escalate.

A couple of clarifying questions so the bridge letter includes exactly what you need:
- Do you require the one-paragraph attestation about major incidents/new subprocessors (you mentioned it above)? If so, please confirm the exact wording you'd like — we can mirror your suggested text.
- Is Acme's legal team going to need the auditor contact/details included in the cover email?

We'll send the SOC PDF and the bridge letter drafts as attachments.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Head of Sales, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, kimberly.park@redwood.com
Date: 2026-02-16T09:30:00-08:00
Subject: Draft: SOC 2 package and proposed bridge letter

Marissa / Kim —

Attaching the materials for Acme: preliminary SOC 2 report PDF and a draft bridge letter for review. Summary:

- SOC 2 Type II report covers 2024-10-01 to 2025-09-30; report issued by Brightline CPA LLP on 2025-11-20.
- Scope: Security, Availability, Confidentiality. No exceptions that materially affect system availability were noted.
- Observed changes since 2025-09-30: routine minor configuration updates and the addition of two third-party monitoring subprocessors (listed in Controls_Summary). No security incidents meeting our incident classification threshold have occurred since 2025-09-30.

Draft bridge letter notes:
- Proposed coverage end date: 2026-02-28.
- One-paragraph attestation included that there have been no material changes to our control environment affecting the Trust Services Criteria since the report end date.
- We included a short section on change control and subprocessors referencing the Controls_Summary spreadsheet.

Attachments (stubs): SOC2_TypeII_20241001-20250930.pdf; Bridge_Letter_Draft_20260216.docx; Controls_Summary_20260216.xlsx

Please review and let me know any edits or additions you want prior to finalizing. If Acme needs the auditor to confirm anything directly we can request a limited confirmation from Brightline but typically the bridge letter + SOC report suffice for procurement.

-Aditya
Director, Security and Compliance
Redwood Inference
From: Elena Martinez <security@acme-corp.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@acme-corp.com
Date: 2026-02-18T10:15:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Draft: SOC 2 package and proposed bridge letter

Thanks, Aditya — appreciate the quick turnaround and the draft. A couple of small asks before we mark the package complete for procurement:

1) Please expand the bridge letter attestation to explicitly state whether there have been any MAJOR security incidents (as defined by our questionnaire) since 2025-09-30. If there are none, a single sentence stating "No major security incidents affecting Redwood's production services have occurred since 2025-09-30" will suffice.
2) Please add a brief sentence confirming that no NEW third-party subprocessors that handle customer data were onboarded after 2025-09-30, or if there were, list them in the Controls_Summary.

If you can incorporate those two bullets into the final bridge letter and send the signed PDF by COB 02/19/2026 we can proceed with the purchase order.

Best,
Elena Martinez
Senior Security Analyst, Acme Corporation
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Elena Martinez <security@acme-corp.com>, procurement@acme-corp.com
Cc: aditya.rao@redwood.com, kimberly.park@redwood.com
Date: 2026-02-19T14:45:00-08:00
Subject: Final: SOC 2 report and signed coverage letter (covers through 2026-02-28)

Elena —

Thanks for the guidance. Attached are the finalized items:

- SOC2_TypeII_20241001-20250930.pdf (Brightline CPA LLP, report date 2025-11-20)
- Bridge_Letter_Final_20260219.pdf (signed) — attestation language included per your request: "No major security incidents affecting Redwood's production services have occurred since 2025-09-30. No new third-party subprocessors that handle customer data were onboarded after 2025-09-30."

We set the bridge coverage date through 2026-02-28. If Acme's legal or procurement teams need a copy of the auditor contact or prefer a direct confirmation from Brightline CPA LLP, please let me know and we can coordinate that next step.

Looking forward to getting you turned on — happy to hop on a quick call if helpful.

Best regards,

Marissa Cole
Head of Sales, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
Attachments: SOC2_TypeII_20241001-20250930.pdf (stub); Bridge_Letter_Final_20260219.pdf (stub)
